# Assumption of Moses Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Final Persecution

---

**1** And they will persecute and torment those who are righteous, saying: let us be like them.

**2** At that time kings from the east will rise against them, come and seize them.

**3** A mighty king will arise, a judge over the whole earth, and he will oppress them.

**4** He will be a man of power and audacity, a severe judge who punishes those who fall away.

**5** He will crucify those who confess their ways and put their cities to the sword.

**6** He will burn their cities with fire and remove their sacred objects.

**7** He will set their sanctuary on fire and eradicate all their heritage, wiping out the righteous from among them.

**8** They will be put to death, plundered, and tortured.

**9** Because they were not faithful, they will receive a punishment worthy of their wickedness.

**10** They will be punished by the sword and taken captive.

**11** Some of them will be destroyed and left desolate.

**12** He will come against them with great fury, and the houses of their holy ones will be torn down.

**13** In those days there will be a tribulation such as has never been since the beginning of the world.

**14** Even the ancient patriarchs could not have endured such tribulation.

**15** Those who have been righteous will mourn for their brothers.
